judge.reason: The answer makes the lead the single owner of one full-suite run on a frozen, recorded current revision. It rejects the previous-revision green and limits the builder to focused checks and the reviewer to read-only review with named check requests. It fabricates no results, spawns no new supervisor, and requires a matching revision record, green counts and log location before acceptance. One weakness is that it doesn't explicitly route the full-run record back to the reviewer, and its allowance to skip a full rerun after a review-driven repair is a judgment call rather than a coverage violation.
